text: 还原 counts 越接近真实执行 counts，PGO 效果越好。

传统目标:
    minimize || inferred counts - true counts ||

DRAPER 目标:
    minimize expected decision loss
      = sum over PGO predicates of
            cost(flip predicate) * probability(flip predicate)

IR:
    caller
      cs1 -> callee
    callee:
      B1
      B2
      B3
      loop:
        L_body

binary:
    caller:
      inlined.B1
      inlined.B2
      inlined.B3
      unroll.body.1
      unroll.body.2
      unroll.body.3
      unroll.body.4

inlined.B1          <- identity/inline(B1)
inlined.B2          <- identity/inline(B2)
inlined.B3          <- identity/inline(B3)
unroll.body.k       <- clone(L_body, k=1,2,3,4)
caller.cs1.entry    <- inline(callee.entry, cs1)

inlined.B1          : 80 samples
inlined.B2          : 40 samples
inlined.B3          : 20 samples
unroll.body.1       : 25 samples
unroll.body.2       : 30 samples
unroll.body.3       : 20 samples
unroll.body.4       : 25 samples

采样率 q    = 1/1000
噪声 sigma  = sqrt(sample + 1)
unroll 覆盖 = 高

sum(incoming L_body) == sum(outgoing L_body)
callee entry == sum(caller edge cs1)

callsite count = 80000
margin = benefit/cost - threshold = 0.12
标准差   = 0.11

尽量保持原 counts
+ 尽量把 margin 推到安全侧
subject to:
    caller/callee 流守恒
    counts 非负
    ||修正量||_1 <= budget

entity: callee.B3
count: 20000
interval: [15800, 24700]
mapping: inlined-from-callee.B3
decision_tags:
  layout: stable-cold

entity: caller.cs1
count: 80000
interval: [71000, 89000]
decision_tags:
  inline: risky-hot
  policy: conservative
